# Simple Grammar — basic two-rule spec

Covers: rule labels, action edges, lifecycle blocks (I/LE/E), regex anchors, accumulator.

## input.spec

```text
DemoParser::
 /pattern1/ -> Child {
 LE { results += :retv }
 E { return(array("?results:", copy(results))) }
 }

Child::
 /hello[ \t]+(\w+)/
 I { name = entry_group(1) }
 E { return(:name) }
```

## input.txt

```
pattern1 hello world
```

## expected.json (generated by Perl reference backend)

The expected result structure — actual values to be generated from the Perl reference
implementation:
- Top-level key `"?results:"` with an array containing the child's return value `"world"`.
